records.label: Monthly wage-index growth
records.modelMapping: realWage; wage/cpi; common normalization required.
records.notes: Regular-hours monthly wage index. It differs from the total wage index and taxable wage bill. The September wage observation was not available as of 30 September.

records.label: Monthly wage-index monthly growth

records.label: Basic wage-index growth
records.modelMapping: Reference; no separate model basic-wage state.
records.notes: Basic wages exclude irregular payments. The monthly change was +0.2%.

records.label: Real wage-index growth (matched-month derivation)
records.modelMapping: realWage; wage/cpi
records.notes: (August 2026 wage 1149.3 / August 2025 wage 1087.7) / (August 2026 CPI 694.6 / August 2025 CPI 657.6) − 1. Calculated from displayed rounded levels, giving approximately +0.0348%. CPI source: https://px.hagstofa.is/pxen/api/v1/en/Efnahagur/visitolur/1_vnv/1_vnv/VIS01000.px. The existing +0.09% approximation uses rounded growth rates of 5.7% and 5.6%. This derivation is not the official real wage index, which may interpolate CPI to mid-month. Use August CPI when comparing August wages.

records.notes: Total earnings index; differs from the regular-hours monthly wage index.

records.label: Total taxable wages

records.label: All taxable payments, Young age-allocation proxy
records.modelMapping: Calibration households.young_18_34 payment and benefit shares; age-allocation proxy
records.notes: PAYE taxable payment amounts to individuals, in current prices, summed over the stated months. Preliminary and recalculated at each update. Financial income and calculated remuneration of self-employed people are excluded; this is not all household income. Amounts are rounded to million ISK in the monthly source. Payments include gross wages before deducting pension contributions, occupational/private pension withdrawals, and the explicitly stated benefit categories. Age proxies reproduce calibration: young = ages 20–34 plus HALF of the 15–19 band; working = 35–64 plus 2/5 of 65–69; old = 70+ plus 3/5 of 65–69. The half-band young assumption is not a uniform age allocation: ages 18–19 would be 2/5 of five ages. The working/old split also assumes uniform payment amounts across ages 65–69, which is not directly observed. No exact current 18–34/35–66/67+ partition is supplied by the source.

records.notes: PAYE taxable payment amounts to individuals, in current prices, summed over the stated months. Preliminary and recalculated at each update. records.label: CBI key rate: seven-day term deposits
records.modelMapping: keyRate; today's observed start, not i0
records.notes: In force since 19 August; 30 September CSV observation confirms 8.00. i0 = 3% is the assumed neutral real rate, while the solved stationary key rate is 3% because piT = 0.

records.label: CBI inflation target
records.modelMapping: Official context for piT; model piT = 0 is a stationary-baseline assumption
records.notes: Target is an annual CPI inflation rate, not today's inflation observation or a price-index level.

records.label: CBI current-account rate
records.modelMapping: External interest-rate context; not a model bond coupon or i0
records.notes: Official dated CSV observation; this facility is different from the seven-day term-deposit key rate.

records.label: CBI overnight lending rate
records.modelMapping: External interest-rate context; not a model bond coupon or i0
records.notes: Official dated CSV observation; this facility is different from the seven-day term-deposit key rate.

records.label: CBI seven-day collateralised lending rate
records.modelMapping: External interest-rate context; not a model bond coupon or i0
records.notes: Official dated CSV observation; this facility is different from the seven-day term-deposit key rate.

records.label: REIBOR three-month offer rate
records.modelMapping: External interest-rate context; not a model bond coupon or i0
records.notes: Official dated CSV observation. REIBOR is a quoted interbank offer rate, not the transaction-based overnight IKON rate.

records.label: Model neutral real key-rate assumption
records.modelMapping: i0 = 3%; rStar is learned within an assumed band
records.notes: No directly observed neutral real rate was identified. It is an economic estimate/assumption and must not be replaced by the 8% nominal policy rate or by simply subtracting one current inflation statistic.

records.label: Landsbankinn new non-indexed floating mortgage
records.modelMapping: mortgageRateN; sMN is an assumed 1 percentage point
records.notes: Up to 90% LTV; key-rate base 8.00% plus fixed margin 2.50%. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Íslandsbanki new non-indexed floating mortgage
records.modelMapping: mortgageRateN; sMN is an assumed 1 percentage point
records.notes: Portion within 50% LTV; excess portion 10.60%; whole-loan rates therefore rise with LTV. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Arion new non-indexed floating mortgage
records.modelMapping: mortgageRateN; sMN is an assumed 1 percentage point
records.notes: Portion within 50% LTV; 50–70% portion carries an additional 1 percentage point. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Landsbankinn three-year fixed non-indexed mortgage
records.modelMapping: Fixed-rate cohort comparator; model mortgageRateN is homogeneous and variable
records.notes: Up to 55% LTV; rate resets after three years. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Íslandsbanki three-year fixed non-indexed mortgage
records.modelMapping: Fixed-rate cohort comparator; model mortgageRateN is homogeneous and variable
records.notes: Low-LTV base tier; rate resets after three years. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Arion three-year fixed non-indexed mortgage
records.modelMapping: Fixed-rate cohort comparator; model mortgageRateN is homogeneous and variable
records.notes: Portion within 50% LTV; excess portion has a margin. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Landsbankinn new indexed mortgage
records.unit: % per year, indexed coupon excluding CPI
records.modelMapping: mortgageRateI; rMI0 = 2.5% assumed real coupon
records.notes: Fixed for loan life, up to 75% LTV; CPI indexation increases principal separately. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Íslandsbanki new indexed mortgage
records.unit: % per year, indexed coupon excluding CPI
records.modelMapping: mortgageRateI; rMI0 = 2.5% assumed real coupon
records.notes: Fixed for five years, portion within 50% LTV; CPI indexation increases principal separately. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. records.label: Arion new indexed mortgage
records.unit: % per year, indexed coupon excluding CPI
records.modelMapping: mortgageRateI; rMI0 = 2.5% assumed real coupon
records.notes: Fixed for three years, portion within 50% LTV; CPI indexation increases principal separately. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. records.label: Arion legacy indexed variable mortgage

records.label: Landsbankinn ordinary current-account deposit

The July flow covers deposit institutions, pension funds, HMS and ÍL, at constant prices whose base is not stated in the sheet. The August bank-only flow is nominal and unsmoothed. Published net-new lending subtracts excess prepayments, excluding scheduled amortisation; the model subtracts scheduled amortisation and loan retirement on sales. The chart is a simulated annual cash-flow rate divided by nominal GDP. Reconcile lender scope, price base, scheduled repayments and time period before comparison; CPI indexation is not new credit.

currentReferences.label: Net new household mortgage lending
currentReferences.unit: bn ISK per month, constant prices (base not stated)
currentReferences.notes: Freshly retained official chart workbook I-30. New lending less debt retirement and prepayments in excess of contractual requirements; includes deposit institutions, pension funds, HMS and ÍL. Both workbook and report specify constant prices but do not state the reference date in this chart. The bank new-credit definition excludes scheduled amortisation from prepayments, while the model's mortgageRepayment includes scheduled amortisation and loans retired on sale; an exact principal-flow match therefore requires reconciliation. It is not certified nominal July cash flow and is not the mortgage-stock change, which also includes CPI indexation. Do not divide this already-monthly flow by 12 again.

currentReferences.label: Bank net new residential mortgage lending
currentReferences.unit: bn ISK per month, nominal claim value
currentReferences.notes: New credit less excess prepayments, deposit takers only; excludes PF, HMS/ÍL and other lenders. Floating-rate mortgages −12.678802907 bn plus fixed-rate mortgages 20.343946184 bn. Includes renegotiated contracts with offsetting prepayments when net funds do not change. Claim value includes accrued interest and indexation; prepayments exclude normal contractual amortisation. The model's mortgageRepayment includes scheduled amortisation and debt retired on sale, so this statistic is not its exact net principal-stock flow or the change in outstanding mortgage stock. Already monthly: do not divide by 12 again.
